description: Untouchable Hand (Legendary perk) in House of Pips: Your remaining pips can never score for Rival.
html:
Perks › Legendary

Untouchable Hand

Legendary perk · Hand award

Your remaining pips can never score for Rival.

In-game card text

How it works

When you lose a hand, your remaining bones award the winner nothing.

  • It works on both blocked hands and when the winner goes domino.
  • It overrides every other hand award effect, including Heavy Hand and Exposed Hand.

At a glance

RarityLegendary
TypeHand award
How to get itComplete its three career trials (Win 25 hands; Win 5 clean hands; Bank a 50-point hand), then unlock it for 1,500 Bone Bucks.
